result.summary: Page is mostly intact but shows visual defects: blank top-right profile button and inconsistent favorite-icon styling, plus clipped scrollable content at the right edge.

issues.description: Top-right header button appears as an empty light-grey circle with only a small red notification dot, with no avatar, profile or bell icon loaded inside
issues.suggestion: Ensure user avatar or default profile/notification icon loads with a proper fallback placeholder if image fails

issues.description: Favorite heart button treatment is inconsistent in Popular right now section: first card (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a bare white outline with no background scrim, second card (pizza) shows heart inside a dark translucent circle
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent circular background/scrim, size and touch target to all favorite buttons for visibility and consistency

issues.description: Scrollable rows clip at the right viewport edge with partially visible category chip and truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' and image
issues.suggestion: Add proper start/end padding to horizontal scrollers and use ellipsis for truncated names to make clipping look intentional
